26400.meaning1: belonging to the four directions; of the four quarters
26400.commentary: (VINa) āgatānāgatassa cātuddisassa saṅghassā'ti āgatassa ca anāgatassa ca catūsu disāsu appaṭihatacārassa cātuddisassa saṅghassa.

examples.text: yo kho, brāhmaṇa, cātuddisaṃ saṅghaṃ uddissa vihāraṃ karoti, ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yañño imāya ca tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukulayaññena app'aṭṭhataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti.

26401.meaningLit: discourse on free to move around

26402.meaning2: belonging to the four continents; extending over the four continents; having control over the four continents

26403.meaning2: covering the four continents or sweeping over the whole earth

examples.text: thero'pi taṃkhaṇaṃ'y'eva gantvā mahābrahmuno dhammaṃ desesi, tato paṭṭhāya cātuppadikaṃ gāthaṃ kathento'pi catusaccavimuttaṃ nāma na kathesī'ti.

26407.meaning1: four-way intersection; crossroads; meeting of four great roads

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī cātumahāpathe nikkhittā assa. atha cha purisā āgaccheyyuṃ byābhaṅgihatthā. te yavakalāpiṃ chahi byābhaṅgīhi haneyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī suhatā assa chahi byābhaṅgīhi haññamānā.
seyyathā'pi, poṭṭhapāda, puriso cātumahāpathe nisseṇiṃ kareyya pāsādassa ārohaṇāya.

26408.meaning1: composed of four primary states; made of the four great elements
26408.meaning2: consisting of the four great elements

examples.text: gaṇḍo'ti kho, bhikkhave, imass'etaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummās'ūpacayassa anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammassa.
ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummāsa-upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

26409.meaning1: belonging to the realm of the four great kings

examples.text: santi devā cātumahārājikā, santi devā tāvatiṃsā, santi devā yāmā, santi devā tusitā, santi devā nimmānaratino, santi devā paranimmitavasavattino, santi devā brahmakāyikā, santi devā tat'uttari.

aṭṭha kho imā, sāriputta, parisā. katamā aṭṭha? khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, cātumahārājikaparisā, tāvatiṃsaparisā, māraparisā, brahmaparisā, imā kho, sāriputta, aṭṭha parisā.

26410.meaning1: realm of the Four Great Kings
26410.commentary: (ANa) sahassaṃ cātumahārājikānan'ti sahassaṃ cātumahārājikānaṃ devalokānaṃ. yasmā pana ek'ekasmiṃ cakkavāḷe cattāro cattāro mahārājāno, tasmā cattāri mahārājasahassānī'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: cātumahārājikānaṃ sahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahassaṃ yāmānaṃ sahassaṃ tusitānaṃ sahassaṃ nimmānaratīnaṃ

26411.meaning1: assembly of gods in the realm of the four great kings

examples.text: aṭṭha kho imā, sāriputta, parisā. katamā aṭṭha? khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, cātumahārājikaparisā, tāvatiṃsaparisā, māraparisā, brahmaparisā, imā kho, sāriputta, aṭṭha parisā.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā cātumāyaṃ viharati āmalakīvane.

26413.meaning1: time of one season; period of four months

examples.text: adaḍḍhā'pi vuccati jātā pathavī. yo'pi paṃsupuñjo vā mattikāpuñjo vā atirekacātumāsaṃ ovaṭṭho, ayam'pi vuccati jātā pathavī.

26414.meaning1: full moon of the fourth month (of a season); full moon marking the transition of one season to another
26414.commentary: (MNa) komudiṃ cātumāsinin'ti pacchima-kattika-cātumāsa-puṇṇamaṃ. sā hi kumudānaṃ atthitāya komudī, catunnaṃ vassikānaṃ māsānaṃ pariyosānattā cātumāsinī'ti vuccati.
26414.notes: (MW) full-moon day at the Cāturmāsya sacrifices. cāturmāsya, 3 sacrifices performed at the beginning of the 3 seasons of 4 months

examples.text: idh'ev'āhaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ komudiṃ cātumāsiniṃ āgamessāmī'ti. assosuṃ kho jānapadā bhikkhū, bhagavā kira tatth'eva sāvatthiyaṃ komudiṃ cātumāsiniṃ āgamessatī'ti.
kattikapuṇṇaman'ti kattikacātumāsinī vuccati.

26415.meaning1: on the full moon of the fourth month (of a season); on the full moon marking the transition of one season to another
26415.meaning2: (the day of the full moon) which ends a four-month period (of rains residence)
26415.commentary: (DNa) cātumāsiniyā'ti cātumāsiyā, sā hi catunnaṃ māsānaṃ pariyosānabhūtā'ti cātumāsī. idha pana cātumāsinī'ti vuccati. māsapuṇṇatāya utupuṇṇatāya saṃvaccharapuṇṇatāya puṇṇā sampuṇṇā'ti puṇṇā. mā iti cando vuccati, so ettha puṇṇo'ti puṇṇamā. evaṃ puṇṇāya puṇṇamāyā'ti imasmiṃ padadvaye ca attho veditabbo.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tadah'uposathe pannarase komudiyā cātumāsiniyā puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā rāj'āmaccaparivuto uparipāsādavaragato nisinno hoti.

26416.construction:
catu > cātu + *mā + eyya + ka
cātumeyya + ka

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi, uṭṭheth'āvuso, gaṇhatha pattacīvaraṃ. pasādito bhagavā cātumeyyakehi ca sakyehi brahmunā ca sahampatinā bīj'ūpamena ca taruṇ'ūpamena cā'ti.

26417.meaning1: four-way intersection; crossroads; meeting of four great roads

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, māyākāro vā māyākār'antevāsī vā cātummahāpathe māyaṃ vidaṃseyya.

26418.meaning1: composed of four primary states; made of the four great elements

examples.text: vammiko'ti kho, bhikkhu, imass'etaṃ cātummahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ, mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummās'ūpacayassa anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammassa.

26419.meaning2: belonging to the retinue of four Deva kings, inhabiting the lowest Deva heaven
26419.commentary: (DNa) yena cātumahārājikā'ti samīpe ṭhitam'pi bhagavantaṃ apucchitvā dhammatāya codito devatā mah'ānubhāvāti maññamāno upasaṅkami.

examples.text: bhummānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā cātummahārājikā devā saddam'anussāvesuṃ, lābhā vata bho vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā tāvatiṃsā devā saddam'anussāvesuṃ

26420.meaning1: realm of the Four Great Kings

examples.text: sahassaṃ cātummahārājikānaṃ sahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahassaṃ yāmānaṃ sahassaṃ tusitānaṃ sahassaṃ nimmānaratīnaṃ sahassaṃ paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ.

26421.meaning1: assembly of gods in the realm of the four great kings
26421.meaning2: assembly of gods in the realm of the four great kings

examples.text: katamā aṭṭha? khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, cātummahārājikaparisā, tāvatiṃsaparisā, māraparisā, brahmaparisā. abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, ānanda, anekasataṃ khattiyaparisaṃ upasaṅkamitā.

26422.meaning1: fourfold restraint; four types of self-control
26422.commentary: (SNa) cātuyāmasusaṃvuto'ti cātuyāmena susaṃvuto. cātuyāmo nāma sabbavārivārito ca hoti sabbavāriyutto ca sabbavāridhuto ca sabbavāriphuṭo cā'ti ime cattāro koṭṭhāsā.

examples.text: jegucchī nipako bhikkhu, cātuyāmasusaṃvuto, diṭṭhaṃ sutañ'ca ācikkhaṃ, na hi nūna kibbisī siyā'ti.

26423.meaning1: restraint by the fourfold restraint; control by the four types of self-control
26423.meaning2: control in regards to the four restraints
26423.commentary: (DNa) cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto'ti catukoṭṭhāsena saṃvarena saṃvuto. (DNa) cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto'ti catubbidhena saṃvarena pihito.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya, labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya, evam'eva kho me, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno cātuyāmasaṃvaraṃ byākāsi.

26424.meaning1: restrained by the fourfold restraint; controlled by the four types of control
26424.commentary: (MNa) cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto'ti na pāṇam'atipāteti, na pāṇam'atipātayati, na pāṇam'atipātayato samanuñño hoti. na adinnaṃ ādiyati, na adinnaṃ ādiyāpeti, na adinnaṃ ādiyato samanuñño hoti. na musā bhaṇati, na musā bhaṇāpeti, na musā bhaṇato samanuñño hoti. na bhāvitam'āsīsati, na bhāvitam'āsīsāpeti, na bhāvitam'āsīsato samanuñño hotī'ti iminā catukoṭṭhāsena saṃvarena saṃvuto.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto sabbavārivārito sabbavāriyutto sabbavāridhuto sabbavāriphuṭo.

26425.meaning1: well restrained by the fourfold restraint; completely controlled by the four types of control
26425.commentary: (SNa) cātuyāmasusaṃvuto'ti cātuyāmena susaṃvuto. cātuyāmo nāma sabbavārivārito ca hoti sabbavāriyutto ca sabbavāridhuto ca sabbavāriphuṭo cā'ti ime cattāro koṭṭhāsā.

examples.text: jegucchī nipako bhikkhu, cātuyāmasusaṃvuto, diṭṭhaṃ sutañ'ca ācikkhaṃ, na hi nūna kibbisī siyā'ti.

26427.meaning1: four points of the compass; four corners of the world; the entire world
26427.commentary: (ANa) cāturanto'ti puratthimasamudd'ādīnaṃ catunnaṃ samuddānaṃ vasena cāturantāya pathaviyā issaro.

examples.text: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti
cātuvaṇṇisuddhiṃ mayaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ apucchimhā, cātuvaṇṇisuddhiṃ bhagavā byākāsi, tañ'ca pan'amhākaṃ ruccati c'eva khamati ca, tena c'amhā attamanā.

26433.meaning1: concerned with the four castes; related to the four social classes
26433.construction:
catu > cātu + vaṇṇa + *a + ī
cātuvaṇṇa + ī

examples.text: cātuvaṇṇisuddhiṃ mayaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ apucchimhā, cātuvaṇṇisuddhiṃ bhagavā byākāsi, tañ'ca pan'amhākaṃ ruccati c'eva khamati ca, tena c'amhā attamanā.
acaritvā brahmacariyaṃ, aladdhā yobbane dhanaṃ, senti cāpa-atikhīṇā'va, purāṇāni anutthunaṃ.
ahaṃ nāgo'va saṅgāme, cāpato patitaṃ saraṃ, ativākyaṃ titikkhissaṃ, dussīlo hi bahujjano.

26435.meaning1: and disinclined; and averse; (comm) and accompanied with aversion
26435.commentary: (ANa) rāg'ānugataṃ pana cittaṃ abhinataṃ nāma hoti, dos'ānugataṃ apanataṃ. tadubhayapaṭikkhepena na c'ābhinataṃ na c'āpanatan'ti āha

examples.text: atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi, passa samādhiṃ subhāvitaṃ cittañ'ca suvimuttaṃ, na c'ābhinataṃ na c'āpanataṃ na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagataṃ.

26436.meaning1: and disinclined; and averse; (comm) and accompanied with aversion
26436.commentary: (ANa) rāg'ānugataṃ pana cittaṃ abhinataṃ nāma hoti, dos'ānugataṃ apanataṃ. tadubhayapaṭikkhepena na c'ābhinataṃ na c'āpanatan'ti āha

examples.text: yāyaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi na c'ābhinato na c'āpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato, vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati. ayaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatā'ti?

26437.meaning1: chives; garlic chives; Allium schoenoprasum or Allium tuberosum
26437.meaning2: kind of (garlic or) onion; (a spring onion(?))
26437.commentary: (KVt) palaṇḍuk'ādīnaṃ vaṇṇena vā miñjāya vā nānāttaṃ veditabbaṃ, vaṇṇena tāva palaṇḍuko nāma paṇḍuvaṇṇo hoti, bhañjanako lohitavaṇṇo, haritako haritapaṇṇavaṇṇo. miñjāya pana palaṇḍukassa ekā miñjā hoti, bhañjanakassa dve, haritakassa tisso. cāpalasuṇo amiñjako. aṅkuramattam'eva hi tassa hoti.

examples.text: anāpatti palaṇḍuke, bhañjanake, harītake, cāpalasuṇe, sūpasampāke, maṃsasampāke, telasampāke, sāḷave, uttaribhaṅge, ummattikāya, ādikammikāyā'ti.
idaṃ nūn'imass'āyasmato āraññikassa ekass'āraññe serivihārena viharato uddhaccaṃ cāpalyaṃ bahulīkataṃ, tam'enaṃ saṅghagatam'pi samudācaratī'ti, tassa bhavanti vattāro.

26439.meaning1: fickleness; inconsistency; (comm) adorning the bowl and robe
26439.commentary: (DNa) vigatacāpallo'ti, pattamaṇḍanā cīvaramaṇḍanā sen'āsanamaṇḍanā imassa vā pūtikāyassa… kelanā paṭikelanā'ti (vibha. 854) evaṃ vuttacāpallā virahito. (DNt) capalassa bhāvo cāpalyaṃ, cāpallaṃ vā, yena samannāgato puggalo vassasatiko'pi samāno tadahujātadārako viya hoti, tass'edam'adhivacanan'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: capalā'ti pattacīvaramaṇḍan'ādinā cāpallena yuttā.

26440.meaning1: (of arrow) shot from a bow; spent

examples.text: acaritvā brahmacariyaṃ, aladdhā yobbane dhanaṃ, senti cāp'ātikhīṇā'va, purāṇāni anutthunaṃ.

26442.commentary: (UDa) cāpālaṃ cetiyan'ti pubbe cāpālassa nāma yakkhassa vasitaṭṭhānaṃ cāpālacetiyan'ti paññāyittha. tattha bhagavato katavihāro'pi tāya ruḷhiyā cāpālacetiyan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā yena cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. āyasmā'pi kho ānando bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

26443.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Iddhipādasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: na vissase ekatiyesu evaṃ, agārisu pabbajitesu c'āpi, sādhū'pi hutvā na asādhu honti, asādhu hutvā puna sādhu honti.
te c'āpi nūnappajaheyyu dukkhaṃ, ye tvaṃ muni aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya, taṃ taṃ namassāmi samecca nāga, app'eva maṃ bhagavā aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya.

26445.meaning1: or even these; and even these; as well as these

examples.text: pakudhako kātiyāno nigaṇṭho, ye c'āp'ime makkhalipūraṇāse, gaṇassa satthāro sāmaññappattā, na hi nūna te sappurisehi dūre'ti.

26448.meaning2: chowry, tail of the yak used as a whisk

examples.text: anekasākhañ'ca sahassamaṇḍalaṃ, chattaṃ marū dhārayum'antalikkhe, suvaṇṇadaṇḍā vītipatanti cāmarā, na dissare cāmarachattagāhakā.

26449.meaning2: who holds the chowry and parasol

examples.text: kikī'va aṇḍaṃ rakkheyya, cāmarī viya vāladhiṃ, nipako sīlasampanno, mamaṃ rakkhi mahāmuni.
āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca, kulāni c'āyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca, pakkamat'āyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alaṃ te idha vāsenā'ti

26454.meaning1: and this; but this; than this

examples.text: yo c'āyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno tassa'pi kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, vacīsaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu na parikkhīṇo, usmā avūpasantā, indriyāni vippasannāni.
yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo, attā have jitaṃ seyyo, yā c'āyaṃ itarā pajā.
pāṇ'ātipātā veramaṇī, adinn'ādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammākamm'anto.

26456.commentary: (SNPa) sa piṇḍacāraṃ caritvā'ti so bhikkhu bhikkhaṃ caritvā bhattakiccaṃ vā katvā.

examples.text: sa piṇḍacāraṃ caritvā, van'antam'abhihāraye, upaṭṭhito rukkhamūlasmiṃ, āsan'ūpagato muni.

paṭipadāya na saṇṭhātī'ti paṭipattiyaṃ na tiṭṭhati, vattaṃ ajānitvā apucchitabbaṭṭhāne pucchatī'ti attho. ayaṃ pañho nāma cetiy'aṅgaṇe pucchitena na kathetabbo, tathā bhikkhācāramagge gāmaṃ piṇḍāya caraṇakāle.

26460.meaning2: who causes to move or act

examples.text: nanu dubbhissasi maṃ punappunaṃ, muhuṃ muhuṃ cāraṇikaṃ'va dassayaṃ, ummattaken'eva mayā palobhasi, kiñ'c'āpi te citta virādhitaṃ mayā.

26464.meaning1: rule about going on a walking journey

26465.meaning1: wanders on tour (in); walks about (among); is on walking tour (in)

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā videhesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.

26466.grammar: idiom, fem + prp, prp of cārikaṃ carati (+loc)

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūṇaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
atha kho bhagavā kapilavatthusmiṃ yath'ābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi. anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi tadavasari.

26467.meaning1: sets out on walking journey; set out on foot

examples.text: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako yena rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi. anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena rājagahaṃ veḷuvanaṃ kalandakanivāpo, yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
yassa nūna, bhante, kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūṇaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto sāmaṃ sen'āsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo cārikaṃ pakkāmi

26469.meaning1: permitting to take a walking tour

examples.text: kāmesumicchācārī hoti. yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti
mā ca vāt'ātape cārittaṃ anuyuñji, mā te vāt'ātape cārittaṃ anuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ anuddhaṃsesi. vaṇ'ānurakkhī ca, ambho purisa, vihareyyāsi vaṇasāropī'ti.

26475.meaning1: engages closely; visits; engages in intercourse (with)

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati. tam'enaṃ bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, m'āyasmā ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjī'ti.

26476.meaning2: engaged closely; visited; engaged in intercourse (with)
26476.commentary: (MNa) tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hotī'ti evarūpāsu itthīsu sammādiṭṭhisutte vutta-micch'ācāra-lakkhaṇa-vasena vītikkamaṃ kattā hoti.

examples.text: gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti
attadantassa posassa, niccaṃ saññatacārino, n'eva devo na gandhabbo, na māro saha brahmunā, jitaṃ apajitaṃ kayirā, tathārūpassa jantuno.
manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.
atthi, bhikkhave, himavato pabbatarājassa duggā visamā desā, yattha n'eva makkaṭānaṃ cārī na manussānaṃ.
kiṃsū asissāmi kuvaṃ vā asissaṃ, dukkhaṃ vata settha kv'ajja sessaṃ, ete vitakke paridevaneyye, vinayetha sekho aniketacārī.
uppāṭiya cārudassanā, na ca pajjittha asaṅgamānasā, handa te cakkhuṃ harassu taṃ, tassa narassa adāsi tāva'd'e.

26481.meaning1: beautiful to behold; lovely to look at

examples.text: uppāṭiya cārudassanā, na ca pajjittha asaṅgamānasā, handa te cakkhuṃ harassu taṃ, tassa narassa adāsi tāva'd'e.
bhikkhu sassāmikaṃ ākāsaṭṭhaṃ moraṃ gahessāmī'ti purato vā tiṭṭhati, hatthaṃ vā pasāreti, moro ākāse'y'eva pakkhe cāreti, vātaṃ gāhāpetvā gamanaṃ upacchinditvā tiṭṭhati. tassa bhikkhuno dukkaṭaṃ.

26485.meaning1: having made walk; having caused to set going

examples.text: antokumbhiyaṃ ṭhapitaṃ yaṃkiñci pārājikappahonakaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ sakalakumbhiyaṃ cārentassa, pāmaṅg'ādiñ'ca ghaṃsitvā nīharantassa yāva mukhavaṭṭiṃ n'ātikkamati, tāva thullaccayam'eva. tassa hi sabbā'pi kumbhī ṭhānan'ti saṅkhepamahāpaccariy'ādīsu vuttaṃ.

26487.meaning2: caused to get going; made wander

examples.text: āyasmatā ca cālena, āyasmatā ca upacālena, āyasmatā ca kukkuṭena, āyasmatā ca kaḷimbhena, āyasmatā ca nikaṭena, āyasmatā ca kaṭissahena, aññehi ca abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ.

26493.meaning2: causes to shake, causes to agitate
26493.synonym: khobheti, ghaṭṭeti, pavedheti, byāthayati, matheti, loḷeti

examples.text: evaṃ āditte pajjalite pakampite ca loke kenaci'pi kampetuṃ cāletuṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya akampiyaṃ, guṇato ettako'ti tuletuṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya attanā sadisassa abhāvato ca atuliyaṃ. buddh'ādīhi ariyehi eva gocarabhāvan'ābhigamato sevitattā aputhujjanasevitaṃ.

26495.meaning2: having caused to shake, having shaken, having agitated

26497.meaning2: caused to shake, caused to agitate, shook
26497.commentary: (SNa) ākāse pāṇiṃ cālesī'ti nīle gagan'antare yamakavijjutaṃ cārayamāno viya heṭṭhābhāgaṃ uparibhāgaṃ ubhatopassesu pāṇiṃ sañcāresi. idañ'ca pana tepiṭake buddhavacane asambhinnapadaṃ nāma.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā ākāse pāṇiṃ cālesi.
ayoniso manasikārā, maṇḍanaṃ anuyuñjisaṃ, uddhato capalo c'āsiṃ, kāmarāgena aṭṭito.
